title: Entering Pre-Production: Project Moonshine
perex: We are officially in pre-production for our next big game, and we're bringing it to Steam! :)
paragraphs: We've officially kicked off development on our next project (working title: Project Moonshine).
Right now, we are deep in pre-production, putting together the complete game design document and figuring out all the core mechanics.
We can also confirm right now that the game is coming to Steam, with a target release window in the first half of 2027.
We can't wait to share more as soon as we have something solid to show. Stay tuned! :)

title: Welcome to our website
perex: We finally put together a proper home for all our games and updates so everything is right here in one place.
paragraphs: Finally we got our own website up and running. Everything we make is now right here in one place so you can easily check out all our games and updates without searching around.
Thanks for sticking with us and supporting what we do. We are constantly working on new projects and we cannot wait to share more soon.
